title: MoveWell | Learn corrective and everyday exercises
meta.description: Understand corrective and everyday exercises with videos and step-by-step guidance, and perform them correctly.
hero.title: Learn to move well
hero.lead: Every exercise comes with a video, simple steps and the notes that matter: common mistakes and what to be careful about.
how.title: How MoveWell helps
how.1.title: Find the exercise
how.1.text: Browse by body region, equipment and level to find the right exercise to learn.
how.2.title: See it clearly
how.2.text: Watch each exercise in slow motion and on repeat.
how.3.title: Do it step by step
how.3.text: Keep the steps, common mistakes and cautions side by side.
